name: Enigmata
description: Enigmata is a comprehensive suite designed to improve large language models' puzzle reasoning skills, featuring 36 tasks across seven categories with a generator-verifier design for scalable multi-task reinforcement learning training and automatic evaluation. It includes Enigmata-Eval, a rigorous benchmark for puzzle reasoning, supporting fine-grained analysis and integration with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
reputation: A recent research benchmark that is still emerging, with limited but growing use in puzzle-reasoning and RL-with-verifiable-rewards studies.
notes: Includes a generator-verifier design for scalable example generation and automatic evaluation; supports multi-task RL training; benchmark includes 36 tasks across seven categories.
